ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: FixMatch uses your location while the app is open to show tradespeople and garages near you and work out the distance to them. Your location stays on your phone.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: FixMatch uses the camera when you take a picture of the problem, so you can send it to a tradesperson. The picture stays on your phone until you send it.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FixMatch opens your photos when you choose a picture of the problem, so you can send it to a tradesperson. The picture stays on your phone until you send it.
